HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: README: 'a novel self-improving system that iteratively modifies its own code (thereby also improving its ability to modify its own codebase) and empirically validates each change using coding benchmarks'.

value.built_to: README: 'a novel self-improving system that iteratively modifies its own code (thereby also improving its ability to modify its own codebase) and empirically validates each change using coding benchmarks'.
value.pressure: NOT_FOUND_AT_PIN as an explicit motivation statement; the README only states the goal (open-ended evolution of self-improving coding agents validated empirically on SWE-bench/Polyglot) and includes a safety warning that the system executes untrusted model-generated code; the paper abstract is not in the tree.
value.success_means: From the code: each node's overall_performance.accuracy_score (fraction of SWE-bench Verified or Polyglot instances resolved) recorded in metadata.json; the archive grows when children compile (non-empty patch, enough evaluated instances) and, under keep_better, when score >= initial score minus eval_noise; nodes scoring above a threshold (second-highest archive score, min 0.4) get a fuller evaluation. README itself names no metric beyond 'coding benchmarks'.

organs.mechanism: default score_child_prop: weight = 1/(1 + exp(-10*(accuracy - 0.5))) * 1/(1 + archived children), normalised; two parents with replacement
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the 'best' option sorts ascending (picks the worst); the argparse choices list concatenates 'score_child_prop' 'best' into one string, so explicitly passing score_child_prop is rejected (works only as the default)

organs.mechanism: if empty patches are at least 10% of tasks, target them with probability 0.25; else stochasticity with 0.25; else context-length errors with 0.25; else a random unresolved task
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: an empty unresolved list is compared to 0 (always False) and reaches random.choice([]) (IndexError)

organs.mechanism: the parent's lineage is rebuilt by applying every ancestor's patch; a diagnosis model writes a problem statement; the agent edits its own repository for up to 30 minutes; the patch is evaluated on a small subset, then a medium subset only if at least 40% of the small one resolved; accuracy = resolved / submitted pooled over result files
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the full-evaluation threshold and the big task list are loaded but never used

organs.mechanism: default keep_all appends every child with the required keys, a non-empty patch and at least the small subset submitted; keep_better requires accuracy >= initial - 0.1
